INDICATION (as provided by referring clinician): Known history of glioblastoma, surveillance post-treatment
ADDITIONAL HISTORY: Right frontal glioblastoma resection on October 20, 2023
COMPARISON: Brain MRI dated November 1, 2023.
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 3.0 tesla.
MEDICATIONS:
Gadobutrol - 15 mL - Intravenous
FINDINGS:
Postsurgical changes in the right frontal region, consistent with previous craniotomy for glioblastoma resection. The resection cavity shows expected postoperative enhancement and mild surrounding vasogenic edema. No new significant FLAIR hyperintensities are noted. Mild leftward midline shift is present, stable compared to prior.
No evidence of hydrocephalus or herniation. Perfusion study reveals no abnormal hyperperfusion.

IMPRESSION: 
1. Stable postoperative changes in the right frontal lobe following glioblastoma resection. No new enhancement outside of expected postoperative areas.
2. Mild leftward midline shift, unchanged from previous imaging.

INDICATION (as provided by referring clinician): Monitoring known glioblastoma post-chemotherapy
ADDITIONAL HISTORY: Chemotherapy completed January 2023 for right temporal glioblastoma
COMPARISON: Brain MRI dated February 15, 2023.
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were performed at 3 Tesla.
MEDICATIONS:
Gadoteridol - 18 mL - Intravenous
FINDINGS:
Right temporal lobe shows post-treatment changes with residual enhancing tissue consistent with recurrent glioblastoma. Increased FLAIR signal intensity in the surrounding white matter, indicative of treatment-related changes. No new subdural hematoma or other intracranial hemorrhage identified.
No significant mass effect or midline shift. Diffusion-weighted imaging shows restricted diffusion correlating with known tumor areas.

IMPRESSION: 
1. Evidence of recurrent glioblastoma in the right temporal lobe with surrounding treatment-related changes.
2. Stable post-chemotherapy changes without new complications.

MR BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST:  7/19/2023 3:30 PM
INDICATION (as provided by referring clinician): Newly diagnosed glioblastoma, preoperative assessment
ADDITIONAL HISTORY: Right occipital glioblastoma diagnosis confirmed July 10, 2023
COMPARISON: None available.
TECHNIQUE: Multiple sequences through the brain were obtained at 3 Tesla.
MEDICATIONS:
Dotarem - 20 mL - Intravenous
FINDINGS:
Large right occipital mass with heterogeneous enhancement and central necrosis, compatible with glioblastoma. Surrounding vasogenic edema extending into adjacent occipital white matter. Mass effect noted with compression of the occipital horn of the right lateral ventricle, no overt midline shift.
No evidence of intracranial hemorrhage or acute infarction. Perfusion imaging shows increased perfusion within the mass.

IMPRESSION: 
1. Large right occipital glioblastoma with significant surrounding edema and mass effect.
2. Preoperative findings to assist surgical planning.
